sentences.en: The children went to school in spite of the rain.
sentences.zh: 尽管下雨，孩子们还是去上学了。

sentences.en: In spite of the rain, the game was not cancelled.
sentences.zh: 尽管下雨，比赛没有取消。

sentences.en: I saw the sight and laughed in spite of myself.
sentences.zh: 尽管自己极力抑制，我还是笑了。

phrases.zh: 尽管所有努力都失败了
